_comment: OTA-234 — ingested from Arbiter_action_difficulty_table.docx. The Arbiter's 10-tier action-difficulty ladder: level × 3 = DC. SHIPPED APP HAS ITS OWN dc_table.json + per-action DC logic — this table is LORE ONLY (Arbiter narrates 'a Very Hard task, fifteen or better' etc.). New authored content can use the table as a balancing reference. Modifier source list (gear, titles, racial perks) matches what the app's effectiveStats already aggregates.

tiers.name: Very Easy
tiers.description: A simple task that almost guarantees success.
tiers.examples: Picking up a dropped item in an open space, walking across a solid bridge.

tiers.name: Easy
tiers.examples: Retrieving a dropped item near a ledge, recalling basic information from a scroll.

tiers.name: Moderate
tiers.description: Requires focus or moderate skill; failure is possible.
tiers.examples: Climbing a tree for a better view, calming an irritated NPC, picking a simple lock.

tiers.name: Hard
tiers.description: Tasks requiring skill or performed under pressure.
tiers.examples: Grabbing a dangling rope from a ledge, sneaking past a guard, disarming a basic trap.

tiers.name: Very Hard
tiers.description: Risky tasks requiring precision and experience.
tiers.examples: Scaling a sheer wall in the rain, hacking a basic security system under time pressure.

tiers.name: Difficult
tiers.examples: Running across a slick slope, navigating collapsing ruins, retrieving a relic.

tiers.name: Very Difficult
tiers.description: High-risk tasks with serious consequences for failure.
tiers.examples: Battling a powerful Etheric creature, convincing a faction leader to give up key information.

tiers.name: Nearly Impossible
tiers.description: Tasks that push the players' skills to the limits.
tiers.examples: Defeating a heavily armored foe with a dagger, swimming through raging currents.

tiers.name: Impossible
tiers.description: Actions with very slim chances of success.
tiers.examples: Running through a barrage of attacks unscathed, lifting a huge boulder in an adrenaline rush.

tiers.name: Legendary
tiers.description: Superhuman feats, testing the very limits of reality.
tiers.examples: Surviving a fall from a great height with last-second intervention, battling an ancient Etheric entity.

modifierSources.description: Items and equipment provide bonuses to specific tasks (e.g. Tartarian Climbing Gloves +3 to climb).
Arbiter-assigned titles grant permanent bonuses to their domain (e.g. Master Relic Hunter +2 investigation on relics).
Racial abilities make certain tasks easier (e.g. Mud Dweller +2 in swamp terrain, Aetherborn +3 with Etheric devices).
